questions.question: 'A # B' means 'A is the brother of B'. 'A @ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'. 'A & B' means 'A is the husband of B'. 'A % B' means 'A is the wife of B'. If D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V, then how is V related to H?
questions.questionHtml:
'A # B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

If D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V, then how is V related to H?
questions.solution:
Given expression: 'D @ N @ H & Y @ F % V'

D is the daughter of N, N is the daughter of H, H is the husband of Y, Y is the daughter of F and F is the wife of V.

Here, V is the wife's father of H.

questions.question: Which two signs and numbers need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 24 - (9 ÷ 12) + (84 × 4) + 28 = 23
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs and numbers need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

24 - (9 ÷ 12) + (84 × 4) + 28 = 23

options.html: 9 and 4, ÷ and ×

questions.solution:
(4) 12 and 4, ÷ and ×

⇒ 24 - (9 ÷ 12) + (84 × 4) + 28 = 23

After interchanging the sign and numbers:

⇒ 24 - (9 × 4) + (84 ÷ 12) + 28 = 23

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 24 - 36 + 7 + 28

⇒ 59 - 36 = 23

⇒ '24 - (9 × 4) + (84 ÷ 12) + 28 = 23'

A $ B means 'A is the son of B'

A * B means 'A is the sister of B'

If H % I $ J $ K * L, then how is H related to J?
questions.solution:
iven expression: 'H % I $ J $ K * L'

H is the daughter of I, I is the son of J, J is the son of K and K is the sister of L.

Here, H is the son's daughter of J.

questions.question: If today is Friday, which day will it be after 72 days?
questions.questionHtml: If today is Friday, which day will it be after 72 days?
questions.solution:
Given:

Today = Friday

As we know that, on the 72th day, the day will repeat itself.

After 72 days = [(7 × 10) + 2] = 10 weeks + 2 days

Here, we have 2 days left.

After 1 day → Saturday

After 2 days → Sunday

Here, after 72 days will be 'Sunday'.

questions.question: The first modern Olympic Games was held in the year ______.
questions.questionHtml: The first modern Olympic Games was held in the year ______.
questions.solution: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) was founded in 1894, and it was decided that the first modern Olympic Games would be held two years later in Athens, Greece. The first modern Olympic Games were held from April 6 to April 15, 1896, and featured 14 nations and 241 athletes competing in 43 events.The Games were a huge success and helped to revive the ancient tradition of Olympic competition, which had been dormant for more than 1,500 years.

questions.question: In which month of the Islamic calendar is 'Ramadan', a holy time when Muslims around the world fast and focus their attention on giving to charity (known as Zakat), observed?
questions.questionHtml: In which month of the Islamic calendar is 'Ramadan', a holy time when Muslims around the world fast and focus their attention on giving to charity (known as Zakat), observed?
questions.solution: The correct answer is option 1, i.e., the ninth month of the Islamic calendar is Ramadan. Ramadan is considered one of the holiest months in the Islamic calendar, during which Muslims fast from dawn to dusk and engage in spiritual reflection and acts of charity.Ramadan is a time of spiritual growth and self-discipline for Muslims worldwide, and it is believed to be a time when the gates of heaven are open, and the gates of hell are closed.

questions.question: Which of the following trade agreements aims to 'strengthen intra-SAARC economic cooperation to maximise the region's potential for trade and achieving development for their people'?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following trade agreements aims to 'strengthen intra-SAARC economic cooperation to maximise the region's potential for trade and achieving development for their people'?
questions.solution: SAFTA stands for South Asian Free Trade Area and is a trade agreement among the member states of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC).SAFTA was signed in 2004 and came into effect in 2006 with the aim to promote and enhance trade and economic cooperation among the SAARC countries.SAFTA aims to reduce and eliminate tariffs and non-tariff barriers on goods traded within the region, and to address other issues related to trade in services and investment.

questions.question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India enshrines to value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India enshrines to value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture?
questions.solution: Article 51 (A) of the Indian Constitution enshrines the duty of every citizen to value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture.This Article is a part of the Fundamental Duties of citizens, which were added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, of 1976. The main keyword mentioned in the question is "composite culture," which refers to the diverse cultural traditions and practices of the various communities that make up India.

questions.question: Chandragupta Maurya overthrew the Nanda Dynasty of Magadha with the help of ______.
questions.questionHtml: Chandragupta Maurya overthrew the Nanda Dynasty of Magadha with the help of ______.
questions.solution: Chandragupta Maurya overthrew the Nanda Dynasty of Magadha with the help of Vishnugupta, who is also known as Chanakya. Chanakya was a wise and learned scholar who played a crucial role in the rise of the Mauryan Empire.He was the chief advisor to Chandragupta Maurya and helped him in his conquests and administrative policies. It is believed that Chanakya wrote the famous book Arthashastra, which deals with economics, politics, and governance.

questions.question: Which of the following is also known as the 'lender of the last resort'?

questions.question: Which of the following group elements are called chalcogens?

questions.solution: Chalcogens are a group of non-metal elements that have similar chemical properties. questions.question: What is an instrument that sends pulses of electromagnetic energy into the atmosphere to detect rainfall, determine its speed and intensity, and identify precipitation types such as rain, snow or hail?

questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding Parliamentary Committees?

A. A minister cannot be a member of the Public Accounts Committee.

B. The members of the Estimates Committee are nominated by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha.

C. A minister can be a member of the Estimates Committee if he is nominated by the Speaker.

D. A member of the Committee on Public Undertakings will have tenure of 2 years.
questions.solution: Parliamentary Committees are formed to assist the Parliament in its work. There are three types of Parliamentary Committees - Standing Committees, Select Committees, and Joint Committees. The members of these Committees are elected or nominated by the Parliament or its Speaker.According to the rules, a minister cannot be a member of the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) as it is an oversight committee that examines the government's expenditures.

questions.question: When did the All India Congress formalise the demand for 'Purna Swaraj' or full independence for India?
questions.questionHtml: When did the All India Congress formalise the demand for 'Purna Swaraj' or full independence for India?
questions.solution: The All India Congress formalized the demand for 'Purna Swaraj' or full independence for India at its Lahore Session in 1929. This demand was made on January 26, 1930, which was celebrated as Independence Day or 'Purna Swaraj Day'. The Lahore Session was presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru, who delivered the famous 'Tryst with Destiny' speech on the eve of India's independence in 1947. The Lahore Session also adopted the 'Poorna Swaraj Resolution' which declared that the goal of the Congress was complete independence for India.

questions.question: 'A Plan of Economic Development for India' is also known as ______.
questions.questionHtml: 'A Plan of Economic Development for India' is also known as ______.
questions.solution: The correct answer is option 4, i.e., Bombay Plan. Bombay Plan was a set of proposals for the economic development of India, presented by a group of leading industrialists and economists in 1944.It was named after the city where it was drafted, i.e., Bombay (now Mumbai).The plan aimed to create a mixed economy in India, with a balance between the public and private sectors.

questions.question: S 1 and S 2 are two stations which are 195 km apart. A train starts from S 1 at 4:00 pm and moves towards S 2 at the speed of 65 km/h. Another train starts from S 2 at 5:00 pm and moves towards S 1 at the speed of 35 km/h. At what time will the two trains meet?

Another train starts from S<sub>2</sub> at 5:00 pm and moves towards S<sub>1</sub> at the speed of 35 km/h. At what time will the two trains meet?
questions.solution:
In that 1 hour train S1 moves 65 km towards S2

Remaining distance of 195 - 65 = 130 km

Relative speed is 65 + 35 = 100 km/hr

The time will be 130/100 = 1.3 hr after 5 pm

The time will be 5 pm + 1 hr 18 minutes = 6:18 pm

questions.solution:
As per the question,

PB = AB - AP

⇒ 20 - 12 = 8cm

As we know

PA × PB = PD ×  PC

⇒ 12 × 8 = PD × 16

⇒ PD = 6

Then CD = PD + PC 

⇒ 16 + 6 = 22 cm

questions.solution:
Let the total work is the 48 units (LCM of 16 and 12)

The efficiency of Rekha is 48 / 16 = 3 units

The efficiency of Bina is  48 / 12 = 4 units

In 2 days they do 3 + 4 = 7 units

They do 42 units of work in 6 × 2 = 12 days. Then Rekha does 3 units in 1 day.Then Bina does 3 units in 3/4 day 

Total number of days will be 12 + 1 + 3/4 = 13\(\frac{3}{4}\) days

questions.question: A can do 20% of a work in 4 days, and B can do 33 \(\frac{1}{3}\) % of the same work in 10 days. They worked together for 9 days and then C completed the remaining work in 6 days. B and C together will complete 75% of the same work in:
questions.questionHtml: A can do 20% of a work in 4 days, and B can do 33\(\frac{1}{3}\)% of the same work in 10 days. They worked together for 9 days and then C completed the remaining work in 6 days. B and C together will complete 75% of the same work in:
questions.solution:
A does total work in 4 × 5 = 20 days

B does total work in 10 × 3 = 30 days

Let total work is 60 units ( Lcm of 20 and 30)

The efficiency of A is ⇒ 60 / 20 = 3 unit

The efficiency of B is ⇒ 60 / 30 = 2 unit

They does together in 9 days  ⇒ 9 × (3+2) = 45 units

The remaining 60 - 45 = 15 unit done by C in 6 days

Total work done by C in 6 × 4 = 24 days

The efficiency of C is 60 /24 = 2.5 unit

75% of the total work is 60 × 3/4 = 45 units

The combined efficiency of B and C = 4.5

The number of days required is 45 / 4.5 = 10 days

questions.question: The area of the sector of a circle of radius 28 cm is 112 cm 2 . Find the length of the corresponding arc of the sector.
questions.questionHtml: The area of the sector of a circle of radius 28 cm is 112 cm<sup>2</sup>. Find the length of the corresponding arc of the sector.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Area of Sector = (1/2) × Radius × Arc length

112 = (1/2) × 28 × l

112 = 14 × l

l = 112 / 14 = 8 cm

∴ The correct option is B.

Alternate Method

Given:

Radius (r) = 28 cm

Area of sector (A) = 112 cm2

Formula Used:

Area of sector = (Arc length × Radius) / 2

Calculations:

⇒ 112 = (l × 28) / 2

⇒ 112 = l × 14

⇒ l = 112 / 14

⇒ l = 8 cm

∴ The correct option is B.

Additional Information

Arc Length Formula

The length of an arc (l) with central angle θ is given by l = (θ/360) × 2πr.

Sector Area Formula

The area of a sector (A) with central angle θ is given by A = (θ/360) × πr2.

Perimeter of a Sector

The total perimeter of a sector is the sum of the arc length and the two radii: P = l + 2r.

Relationship between Area and Arc Length

Area of sector = (1/2) × r × l, where r is the radius and l is the arc length.

questions.question: If (x 2 - \(\frac{1}{x^2}\) ) = 4 \(\sqrt6\) , and x > 1, what is the value of (x 3 - \(\frac{1}{x^3}\) )?
questions.questionHtml: If (x2 - \(\frac{1}{x^2}\)) = 4\(\sqrt6\), and x > 1, what is the value of (x3 - \(\frac{1}{x^3}\))?
questions.solution:
Given:

(x2 - \(\frac{1}{x^2}\)) = 4\(√6\) = (x + \(\frac{1}{x}\))(x - \(\frac{1}{x}\))               ...(1)

squaring both sides

⇒ (x2 - \(\frac{1}{x^2}\))2 = 16 × 6

⇒ x4 + \(\frac{1}{x^4}\) - 2 = 96

⇒ x4 + \(\frac{1}{x^4}\) = 98

⇒ x4 + \(\frac{1}{x^4}\) + 2 = 98 + 2

⇒ (x2 + \(\frac{1}{x^2}\))2 = 100

⇒ x2 + \(\frac{1}{x^2}\) = 10

⇒ x2 + \(\frac{1}{x^2}\) + 2 = 10 + 2

⇒ (x + \(\frac{1}{x}\))2 = 12

⇒ x + \(\frac{1}{x}\) = √12 = 2√3                                  ...(2)

so

⇒ x - \(\frac{1}{x}\) = 2√2                 [after dividing equation (1) by (2)]

and

(x - \(\frac{1}{x}\))3 = (x3 - \(\frac{1}{x^3}\)) - 3 (x - \(\frac{1}{x}\))

⇒ (2√2)3 = x3 - \(\frac{1}{x^3}\) - 3(2√2)

⇒ 16√2 + 6√2 =  x3 - \(\frac{1}{x^3}\) 

⇒ x3 - \(\frac{1}{x^3}\) = 22√2

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Water gives itself away for our agriculture and other uses.

B. Trees give flowers, fruits and wood.

C. Giving soothes an individual with the vibration of joy.

D. Unconditional giving is a natural principle and evident everywhere in nature which gives us solid, liquids and minerals.
questions.solution: In the given question, by going through the given sentences, the statement C states the subject of the passage. Further sentence D explains the concept of unconditional giving and sentence A and B will further give examples. Thus, the correct order of the sentence is "CDAB."

questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the following sentence. During the wedding ceremony, the bride seemed even quieter and more diffident than usual.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the following sentence.

During the wedding ceremony, the bride seemed even quieter and more diffident than usual.

options.text: Giving a false or misleading impression
options.html: Giving a false or misleading impression

options.text: Shy due to lack of confidence.
options.html: Shy due to lack of confidence.

questions.solution: Diffident refers to a lack of confidence or shyness. It is an adjective that describes a person's personality or behaviour. Example- He is very diffident and needs encouragement. As a result, the most accurate definition of 'diffident' is "shy due to lack of confidence." As a result, option 4 is the right answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'. While he saw the bear , he ran to the nearest tree, dropped his gun and climbed to a safe place.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

While he saw the bear, he ran to the nearest tree, dropped his gun and climbed to a safe place.
questions.solution: "While" typically emphasizes simultaneous actions without strongly indicating a cause-and-effect relationship, whereas "when" is used to highlight a specific trigger event that leads to a subsequent action. In the given sentence, "When" is a more suitable choice because it establishes that the sighting of the bear prompted the person to take immediate action.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution of the given group of words. Capable of or adapted for turning easily from one to another of various tasks, fields of endeavour, etc. and is able to do many things.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution of the given group of words.

Capable of or adapted for turning easily from one to another of various tasks, fields of endeavour, etc. and is able to do many things.
questions.solution: The word "versatile" is used to describe someone or something that is capable of adapting easily to different tasks, roles, or fields of endeavour. It implies a high degree of flexibility and competence in handling various activities or situations. In the context of the description provided, "versatile" perfectly captures the idea of being skilled, adaptable, and capable of handling different tasks and roles.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank. There are ______ (definite) weaknesses in their security arrangements.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.

There are ______ (definite) weaknesses in their security arrangements.
questions.solution: "Vague" is the opposite of "definite." While "definite" means clear, precise, and certain, "vague" refers to something unclear, imprecise, or lacking in detail. Example- Her explanation was so vague that I couldn't grasp the definite meaning of her proposal. Thus, option 4 is the right choice.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. This will be most difficult of /the adjustments we have to make / because we have been used to spending a lot on guests.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

This will be most difficult of /the adjustments we have to make / because we have been used to spending a lot on guests.

options.text: the adjustments we have to make
options.html: the adjustments we have to make

options.text: This will be most difficult of
options.html: This will be most difficult of

options.text: because we have been used to
options.html: because we have been used to

questions.solution: The error lies in missing "the" before "most difficult." It should be "the most difficult of" to specify a particular adjustment among others. Articles like "the" clarify whether we refer to something specific or general. So, it's "the most difficult of the adjustments we have to make" to compare adjustments accurately.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. The family has visit many parts of Europe when the man was working with an international educational agency.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The family has visit many parts of Europe when the man was working with an international educational agency.
questions.solution: "Had visited" is a past perfect tense used to express an activity that occurred before another event in the past. The statement is used in the past tense, emphasising that the family's trips to Europe occurred before the man's departure from the international educational organisation. Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the correct idiom that can substitute the italicised group of words in the given sentence. My business partners thought that I would simply accept their cheating, but they will soon realise that I am more powerful than what they expected.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct idiom that can substitute the italicised group of words in the given sentence.

My business partners thought that I would simply accept their cheating, but they will soon realise that I am more powerful than what they expected.
questions.solution: The idiom "They caught a tartar" means that someone has encountered a person or situation that is much more difficult, formidable, or challenging than they anticipated. It implies that the person or situation turned out to be a lot stronger or more capable than initially thought, leading to unexpected difficulties or struggles.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word. This is such a rowdy classroom.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

This is such a rowdy classroom.
questions.solution: Rowdy's antonym is compliant, which indicates being submissive to or eager to obey regulations. The statement implies that the classroom is boisterous and disorganised, implying that a complying classroom would be the polar opposite. The term rowdy refers to anything or someone who is rough or unruly. In this example, compliant is the perfect antonym since it portrays a well-behaved and rule-following classroom.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. She will probably come tonight for a party.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

She will probably come tonight for a party.
questions.solution: The term 'probably' implies uncertainty or doubt, whereas its antonym is a word that implies assurance or confidence. 'Definitely' is the finest option since it signifies without a doubt. For example- I will probably finish the book tonight, and I will definitely return it to you tomorrow.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Fierce
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fierce
questions.solution: The most appropriate synonym for "fierce" is "aggressive." When something is described as fierce, it implies a strong and intense level of force, energy, or determination. Similarly, when something is considered aggressive, it displays a similar intensity in its approach or behaviour, often involving forcefulness or hostility. Both words convey a sense of powerful and strong action.

questions.solution: "Steadily" is a useful word choice in the provided sentence since it denotes a steady and unwavering effort or advancement across time. The author emphasises that despite problems or failures, they continued to work tirelessly without losing sight of their aim. The word "steadily" emphasises their dedication and persistence in learning how to do anything. It implies a consistent and dependable way of functioning, with no abrupt stops or variations.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
questions.solution: In the given sentence, "alternative" is the appropriate word choice because it conveys the idea that the writer considered different options or choices but couldn't find a better or more suitable one for the given case. The word "alternative" captures the notion of considering different alternatives and underscores the writer's decision to stick with the structure they ultimately chose.
